_about: Public-domain Clovis G. Chappell (1882-1972), Methodist preacher of Washington, Memphis and Houston, for the Word Hoard: his books of sermons printed before 1930, in printings whose imprints date them before 1930: More Sermons on Biblical Characters (1923), Sermons on New Testament Characters (1924), Home Folks (1926), Christ and the New Woman (1928) and Men that Count (1929). He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 108 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

chappell-more-biblical: More sermons on Biblical characters (New York, George H. Doran company, 1923)
chappell-nt-characters: Sermons on new testament characters (george h. doran company, 1924)
chappell-new-woman: Christ and the new women (Nashville, Tenn. : Cokesbury press, 1928)
chappell-men-that-count: Men that count (doubleday, doran & company, inc., 1929)

_excluded.chappell-1930-on: Books printed in 1930 or later (The Sermon on the Mount and after) left out
